indicator_name: Official USD/KZT Exchange Rate, monthly average (NBK)
description: Официальный курс USD/KZT, в среднем за месяц (НБК)
methodology: NBK monthly average of the official USD/KZT rate, KZT per USD, as published in the NBK's yearly files «Официальные обменные курсы иностранных валют в YYYY году» (2017-2022 PDF, from 2023 xlsx). Not the weekday mean of EXCHANGE_RATE (differs by up to 0.7 % in volatile months and by 1.7 % in 2023-08, when the daily report has no rate for 2023-07-28..2023-08-21).
